title: 煅玉堂 第八十三章 轩逸宫来人煅玉堂 第八十二章 被压制
content_zh:
“真仙大能！”
秦凤鸣身形偏转，身形闪动，手中迅疾扣中了数名乾冥晶石。还未等他出手，急追的窦德真仙骤然停下了身躯。秦凤鸣未逃，身形停在了一座山丘上。
秦凤鸣没有惊恐，他感觉这位急速而至之人似乎不是敌人。
“你是何人？”窦德真仙不认识来人，停身，断然喝问。
来人是一位年岁只有二十多岁的青年修士，身上气息因为被这里的天地压制，并不如何显现，但神魂涌动，明显是真仙才有的神魂气息。
“老夫戴尧，乃是轩逸宫之人。道友是何人？”青年修士看向窦德真仙，同样不识。
弥罗界太过浩瀚，别说真仙，就是道君都未必每个仙宫区域都走遍过。
秦凤鸣心头砰跳，轩逸宫，他可是熟悉，因为他身上就有一件轩逸宫物品在身。这位轩逸宫真仙大能，难道是冲他身上那件物品而来的？
“老夫魔阴宫窦德，道友难道要插手我魔阴宫的事？”窦德瞪视青年，语气非常不善。他头顶之上神魂云雾依旧翻腾，道道青色弧光在云层中隐现，恐怖神魂能量涌动，已经做好了争斗准备。
“魔阴宫道友好大口气，插手争斗又如何？来来来，你我争斗一场。”
让窦德真仙陡然心中暗呼不妙，逸轩宫真仙青年根本就不担心惹麻烦，看视一眼空中翻滚的神魂云雾，直接招手道。
话语声中，身上神魂能量汹涌，一头凶兽虚影出现在青年身后。
那是一头神魂能量凝聚而成的凶兽，犹如一头挺立身躯的魔熊，高有三四十丈，通体虚幻，一道道粗大的虚幻灵纹在高大凶兽体内飞射游走。
这是一种神魂神通，一看就非常强大恐怖。
秦凤鸣目光闪动，刹那便猜到了这位轩逸宫真仙来这里所为何事了。于是站立山丘之上，双手倒背，满脸笑意的看着两位强大真仙对峙。
窦德这个气，他明明已经大占上风，眼看就能一击将秦凤鸣重创擒拿，结果出来一个轩逸宫真仙。
“戴尧道友，你真要插手？此事事关我魔阴宫老祖，你真要与我魔阴宫为敌？”窦德真仙瞪视青年，口中冷冷道。他话语不多，但明显充满了威胁意味。
“哼，不管事关何人，今日戴某插手定了。”青年不为所动。
“那就手底见真章吧。”窦德真仙厉喝，手指猛然点指向头顶云雾，顷刻见，一声炸雷自云雾中响彻而出，接着就见一道道青色弧光飞射，如一柄柄锋利刀刃，猛然劈斩向青年真仙。
比刚才攻击秦凤鸣的威能陡然提升了不知多少。

秦凤鸣感觉后背一阵冰寒，如果刚才窦德真仙全力催动攻击，秦凤鸣感觉自己根本无法避过如此密集的电闪攻击。
“好，就试试你的攻击威力如何。”青年暴喝一声，并不闪避，而是同样手臂挥出，身后高大的神魂凶兽猛然发出一声恐怖兽吼，接着就见高大凶兽迈步，直接跨过了青年身躯，迎着一道道蕴含神魂雷电威能的电闪而去。
轰鸣炸响接连响起，一柄柄如同锋利刀锋般的电闪纷纷劈斩在高大虚幻的神魂凶兽身躯之上，一团团暴烈的乌光立即在高大凶兽身上爆闪而现。每一声轰鸣响彻，高大凶兽身躯便会缩小少许。
一道道锋利弧光接连劈斩，本来三四十丈高大的神魂凶兽身躯以肉眼可见的速度急速缩小。然而站立凶兽身后的戴尧真仙双手掐诀，浑身神魂能量激荡汹涌，神情之上没有一点惧意。
content_en:
"True Immortal Power!"
Qin Fengming's body deflected, his body flashed, and he quickly grabbed several Qianming crystals in his hand. Before he could take action, the pursuing Immortal Dou De suddenly stopped. Qin Fengming did not escape, but stopped on a hill.
Qin Fengming was not frightened. He felt that the person who came quickly did not seem to be an enemy.
"Who are you?" Immortal Dou De didn't recognize the visitor, so he stopped and asked flatly.
The person who came was a young monk who was only in his twenties. The aura on his body was not very visible because it was suppressed by the heaven and earth here, but his soul was surging, which was obviously the soul aura of a true immortal.
"I, Dai Yao, am from Xuanyi Palace. Who is fellow Taoist?" The young monk looked at True Immortal Dou De, but he also didn't recognize him.
The Miluo Realm is too vast, not to mention the true immortals, even the Dao Lord may not have visited every area of ​​the immortal palace.
Qin Fengming's heart pounded. He was familiar with Xuanyi Palace because he had an item from Xuanyi Palace on him. Did this Xuan Yi Palace True Immortal Power come here for the item on his body?
"I'm Demon Yin Palace Dou De, do you want to interfere with my Demon Yin Palace's affairs?" Dou De stared at the young man with a very unkind tone. The soul cloud above his head was still billowing, green arcs of light loomed in the clouds, the terrifying soul energy was surging, and he was ready for a fight.
"The Demon Yin Palace is friendly and loud, so what if you intervene in the fight? Come on, let's have a fight between you and me."
True Immortal Dou De suddenly felt something bad in his heart. The young man from Yixuan Palace was not worried about getting into trouble at all. He glanced at the soul cloud rolling in the air and waved directly.
As he spoke, the soul energy surged through his body, and the shadow of a ferocious beast appeared behind the young man.
It was a ferocious beast formed by condensing divine soul energy. It was like a demonic bear with an erect body. It was thirty or forty feet tall, and its entire body was illusory. Thick illusory spiritual patterns flew and swam in the body of the tall ferocious beast.
This is a kind of divine power, which is very powerful and terrifying at first glance.
Qin Fengming's eyes flashed, and he immediately guessed why the Xuanyi Palace True Immortal came here. So he stood on the hill, put his hands behind his back, and watched the confrontation between the two powerful immortals with a smile on his face.
With Dou De's anger, he clearly had the upper hand. He was able to severely injure and capture Qin Fengming with one blow, and a true immortal from Xuanyi Palace emerged as a result.
"Fellow Daoist Dai Yao, do you really want to interfere? This matter concerns my ancestor of the Demonic Palace. Do you really want to be an enemy of my Demonic Palace?" True Immortal Dou De stared at the young man and said coldly. He didn't speak much, but he was obviously full of threats.
"Hmph, no matter who it concerns, Dai will intervene today." The young man was unmoved.
"Then see the real seal in your hand." True Immortal Dou De shouted sharply, pointing his finger at the clouds and mist above his head. Suddenly, a sound of thunder resounded from the clouds and mist, and then saw green arcs of light flying, like sharp blades, suddenly slashing towards the young True Immortal.
The power of attacking Qin Fengming suddenly increased by an unknown amount.
Qin Fengming felt a chill on his back. If Immortal Dou De had launched the attack with all his strength just now, Qin Fengming felt that he would not be able to avoid such a dense lightning attack.
"Okay, let's test the power of your attack." The young man shouted loudly, and instead of dodging, he waved his arms out. The tall beast behind him suddenly let out a terrifying beast roar, and then saw the tall beast step forward, directly across the young man's body, and faced the lightning flashes containing the thunder power of the soul.
Roars and explosions sounded one after another, and lightning bolts like sharp blades struck the body of the tall and illusory soul beast. Balls of violent black light immediately flashed on the tall beast. Every time a roar resounds, the body of the tall and ferocious beast will shrink a little.
Sharp arcs struck one after another, and the body of the divine beast, which was originally thirty to forty feet tall, shrank rapidly at a speed visible to the naked eye. However, Dai Yao Zhenxian, who was standing behind the ferocious beast, was making secrets with both hands, and his whole body was full of energy.The soul energy was surging, and there was no fear in his expression.
